name: Ethan
title: The Wise Ezrahite
summary: Ethan the Ezrahite was known as one of the wisest men of his time, but Solomon's wisdom surpassed his. He is traditionally regarded as the author of Psalm 89, a psalm that praises God's faithfulness and covenant with David. He is also mentioned in 1 Chronicles as a Levitical singer.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as one of the wisest men
keyEvents.description: Ethan the Ezrahite is mentioned as an exceptionally wise man, but Solomon's wisdom surpassed his and that of the other wise men.

keyEvents.title: Author of Psalm 89
keyEvents.description: Ethan is credited with authoring Psalm 89, a maskil concerning God's covenant with David and God's faithfulness.

keyEvents.title: Praise of God's Faithfulness
keyEvents.description: In Psalm 89, Ethan sings of the Lord's grace and faithfulness that lasts forever, and about the covenant God made with His chosen servant David.

keyEvents.title: Lament over the Rejected Anointed One
keyEvents.description: In the final part of Psalm 89, Ethan laments that God has seemingly rejected His anointed one and broken the covenant with David, reflecting a national crisis.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among the descendants of Levi as singers
keyEvents.description: Ethan is mentioned in 1 Chronicles as the son of Kishi, from the sons of Merari, one of the Levitical singers appointed by David to serve in the house of the Lord.

keyEvents.title: Service as a musician in the temple
keyEvents.description: Ethan was appointed along with Heman and Asaph to play cymbals as part of the Levitical musical service before the ark of the covenant.
